vertical_reference: EGM96 orthometric heights in metres as specified by Tilezen Skadi documentation
format: gzip compressed, headerless signed int16 big-endian, row-major, north to south rows, west to east columns
coverage: entire proposed site and 75 m context covered by tile extent
dataset_version: Exact published tile snapshot pinned by S3 ETag, Last-Modified and SHA256; no tile-level semantic version declared. Documentation describes releases built 2016/2017.
underlying_source: SRTM expected for Bengaluru by global source coverage; exact contributing images not independently traced against provider footprint database.
license: SRTM/GMTED public-domain source terms and Tilezen provider attribution; see sources/terrain_attribution.md. Do not imply a single newly assigned license for the composite.
attribution: Mapzen/Tilezen; SRTM/GMTED data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey.
initial_simulation_terrain: flat z=0 m model-relative ground is an explicit assumption; DEM retained for later use
caveats: DEM values are not local surveyed bare-earth DTM, LiDAR, roof elevations or usable building heights.
Buildings/vegetation/radar and merging artifacts can affect elevation samples.
About 30 m source sampling cannot resolve curb or sidewalk elevations.
No resampling or terrain-to-roof subtraction was performed.
Actual source acquisition date is older than current buildings/weather and is not the download date.
represents: Composite Skadi elevation product. SRTM/radar-derived elevations are expected here but contributing images are not independently traced. Building/vegetation signals and merging artifacts may be present; do not label as surveyed bare-earth DTM or building roof heights.
original_provider_format: gzip-compressed SRTM-style HGT signed int16 big-endian point grid
requested_filename_warning: elevation_original.tif is a lossless conversion of the preserved native HGT, not an original provider-delivered TIFF.
native_sample_grid: Point samples: first centre (77 E,13 N), last centre (78 E,12 N), 3601 x 3601 including shared tile edges. GeoTIFF pixel-corner transform is half a sample outside centres.
initial_engine_use: Metadata, extent and coarse elevation validation only. Do not modify a flat-ground mesh or use DEM-minus-roof building heights.

flat_ground_model.reference: model-relative, not an absolute orthometric altitude
